Welcome to the learning materials for the Simulation Accelerator. Each session has pre-learning (required self-study before the session) and slides (used during the 1-hour session). You'll apply what you learn to your own project in the [capstone](5_capstone/index.qmd).


| Session | Focus | Objectives | Pre-learning | Slides |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ✨ Map | Map your system and identify the problem you want to solve | [Objectives](1_map/index.qmd) | [Pre-learning](1_map/pre-learning.qmd) | [Slides](1_map/slides.qmd) |
| ❔ Model | Make your projects easy to find and use with clear READMEs, licences, and documentation | [Objectives](2_model/index.qmd) | [Pre-learning](2_model/pre-learning.qmd) | [Slides](2_model/slides.qmd) |
| 🎰 Random | Harness your data and run a stochastic simulation trial | [Objectives](3_random/index.qmd) | [Pre-learning](3_random/pre-learning.qmd) | [Slides](3_random/slides.qmd) |
| � Valid | Build trust in your model through verification and validation | [Objectives](4_valid/index.qmd) | [Pre-learning](4_valid/pre-learning.qmd) | [Slides](4_valid/slides.qmd) |
| 🏆 Capstone | Put it all into practice on a real project with feedback and support | [Objectives](5_capstone/index.qmd) | - | - |
